description:
﻿Varen, an SAIC company is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to join our team. This position in located in Suitland, MD and requires an active TS/SCI with polygraph to be considered.

 Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

 
 Responsible for detailed design, documentation, coding, code optimization, unit testing, deployment, and improvements of desktop and web-based solutions on Microsoft platforms (.NET, ASP.NET, C#, etc.). 

 Performs custom software development when commercial solutions are unavailable.

 Ensures software code is developed and maintained per USG Information Assurance and Security standards. 

 Designs, implements, and manages middleware solutions for communication and data exchange between applications and systems. 

 Ensures seamless integration, optimizes performance, and troubleshoots middleware/application infrastructure issues.

 

 Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.
 TS/SCI with Polygraph.
 Experience with Python.
 
 SAIC®  is a premier mission integrator focused on advancing the power of technology and innovation to serve and protect our world. Our robust portfolio of offerings across the defense, space, intelligence, and civilian markets includes secure high-end solutions in mission IT, enterprise IT, engineering services, and professional services. We integrate emerging technology, rapidly and securely, into mission critical operations that modernize and enable critical national imperatives. 
 
 

 We are approximately 23,000 strong; driven by mission, united by purpose, and inspired by opportunities. SAIC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, SAIC has annual revenues of approximately $7.3 billion. For more information, visit  saic.com . For ongoing news, please visit our  newsroom .
